title: Psalm 117
verses_hebrew_raw: כִּי גָבַר עָלֵינוּ, חַסְדּוֹ-- וֶאֱמֶת-יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם: הַלְלוּ-יָהּ.
verses_hebrew: כִּי גָבַר עָלֵינוּ חַסְדּוֹ וֶאֱמֶת־יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ
verses_english: O praise the LORD, all ye nations; laud Him, all ye peoples.
For His mercy is great toward us; and the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. {N} Hallelujah.
